slice.target: Cargo vendor local dependency artifact preparation
slice.source_finding: Official Cargo documentation states that cargo vendor copies all crates.io and git dependencies into a specified local directory, leaving all remote dependency sources there, and prints configuration needed to use those vendored sources. It also documents offline/frozen operation as depending on locally available crates.
slice.verified_scope: Cargo officially supports materializing dependency source trees into a local directory that can be referenced by Cargo configuration after cargo vendor has been executed.
slice.not_verified_scope: No integrity-metadata file format was verified in this one-source slice; scheduled Chat was not shown able to execute cargo vendor or Cargo itself; end-to-end richer-mode parity remains unverified.

freshness.effect: The public-source observation is retained only as a bounded source finding and is not counted as positive Phase-1 acceptance evidence. No retry was attempted in-run.
